archetypes.name: risk-integration
archetypes.rationale: The SECURITY.md edit removes the mutual-exclusion claim for --emergency and --merge; verifying this doc change matches actual script behavior is the highest-risk aspect of the diff.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on whether the SECURITY.md documentation change — removing the claim that `/implement --emergency` is mutually exclusive with `--merge` — is consistent with what `scripts/implement-preflight.sh` actually enforces. Read `scripts/implement-preflight.sh` and check for any guard that rejects the combination of `--emergency` and `--merge` at runtime; if such a guard exists, the doc change is wrong. Also check whether any other files in the skill surface (e.g. `skills/implement/SKILL.md`, `scripts/session-setup.sh`) reference this mutual-exclusion constraint and would now be stale. Confirm the new wording — 'a merged emergency run still carries the same downgrade warnings and trust-boundary caveats' — accurately represents what the script emits in a combined `--emergency --merge` invocation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
